title: Accelerator and Brake: Dynamic Persuasion with Dead Ends
abstract: arXiv:2601.13686v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper studies dynamic persuasion in a strategic-experimentation relationship in which the principal has a single-peaked preference over the agent's stopping time. Excessive experimentation may end in a dead end. The principal privately observes project quality, which determines the agent's payoff conditional on success, while both parties learn about feasibility only through the agent's experimentation. We show that an optimal policy uses at most two one-shot disclosures: an accelerator before the principal's ideal stopping time and a brake afterward. A local Arrow--Pratt comparison of induced payoffs over stopping time determines whether the accelerator is concentrated or gradual. Under common discounting, the comparison yields a one-shot accelerator. translated_title: 油门与刹车：带有死胡同的动态劝说
translated_abstract: 本文研究战略实验关系中的动态劝说问题，其中委托人对代理人的停止时间具有单峰偏好。过度实验可能以“死胡同”告终。委托人私下观察到项目质量，该质量决定了代理人在成功条件下的收益，而双方只能通过代理人的实验来了解项目的可行性。我们证明，最优策略至多使用两次一次性披露：在委托人理想停止时间之前的“油门”和其后的“刹车”。通过对停止时间上诱导收益的局部Arrow–Pratt比较，可以确定油门是集中的还是渐进的。在共同贴现的情况下，该比较得出一次性的油门。在异质贴现的情况下，一次性结果仍然稳健，除非代理人比委托人足够更缺乏耐心，在这种情况下，排序会在某个区间上发生反转。
tldr: 本文证明了在存在死胡同风险的战略实验关系中，最优动态劝说策略至多包含两次一次性披露——委托人理想停止时间前的“油门”和其后的“刹车”，并通过局部Arrow–Pratt比较刻画了油门何时集中、何时渐进的条件。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that in dynamic persuasion with strategic experimentation and dead-end risk, the optimal policy uses at most two one-shot disclosures—an accelerator before and a brake after the principal's ideal stopping time—with a local Arrow–Pratt comparison determining whether the accelerator is concentrated or gradual.
